source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.claim_status: Report filed within 3 days; locked-boot theft covered if forced entry shown, but lock photo is untimestamped, receipt missing and an unverified witness conflicts, so prefer requesting specific evidence.
reasons.evidence_reliability: Serial number, police report number and lock photo help, but no timestamp, no receipt, thin police report and an unverified conflicting witness keep reliability weak to fair.
reasons.police_report_adequate: Police report omits the loss date and is only two short lines.

reasons.claim_status: Missing receipt and unattached clause text point to requesting evidence or legal review; witness back-seat remark adds some fraud doubt.
reasons.evidence_reliability: Untimestamped photo, no receipt, no CCTV, unverified witness and thin police report make evidence weak.
reasons.police_report_adequate: Police report does not state the loss date and is only two short lines.

ui_dependence: The reference facts supply the clause wording and the report deadline, which determine which exclusion or deadline applies; without them the model cannot tell which statuses are even available.
